# AssetLift Lending

> AssetLift Lending is a direct private money lender providing fast hard money loans for real estate investors nationwide. We are not a broker — we fund from our own balance sheet.

## About
AssetLift Lending specializes in hard money loans for real estate investors. Founded by Yaakov Pentelnik and Israel Pentelnik, we provide fix and flip loans, DSCR rental loans, bridge loans, and ground-up construction financing across 46 states.

## Loan Programs
- Fix & Flip Loans: Up to 92.5% LTC, 100% rehab funded, close in 7-10 days, loans up to $5MM
- DSCR Rental Loans: Up to 80% LTV, 30-year fixed, no personal income verification, loans up to $3MM
- Bridge Loans: Up to 80% LTV, 6-18 month terms, residential and commercial
- Ground-Up Construction: Up to 90% LTC, 100% construction funded, loans up to $5MM

## Key Facts
- Direct lender, not a broker
- Close in 7-10 business days
- Loans from $100K to $5MM
- Lending in 46 states
- 24-hour quote turnaround
- Minimum credit score: 660
